influences.name: Shirley "Cha Cha" Muldowney
influences.context: The album's title and cover pay homage to Shirley "Cha Cha" Muldowney, a pioneering drag racer who inspired Pirner in his youth. "When I was a kid, I loved drag racing," he says. "And she was the first woman of drag race. It meant a lot to me that she was willing to stand up against all these men in racing."

influences.name: Chris Osgood
influences.context: The Suicide Commandos song is unfortunately not written by Chris Osgood, but Chris Osgood is pretty much my mentor. He sort of showed me my first Ramones chords and he was my hero when I was growing up

influences.name: MC5
influences.context: I love the MC5 and they mean everything to me as an influence and an inspiration

influences.name: Wayne Kramer
influences.context: That's why I love the MC5 and that's why I can also say that the other guys in the band are all so awesome... I try to understand how Wayne Kramer and Fred "Sonic" Smith sorted out a lot of stuff that other people picked up on

influences.name: Keith Richards
influences.context: Keith Richards turned me onto Robert Johnson

influences.name: Robert Johnson
influences.context: Keith Richards turned me onto Robert Johnson — there's a few things like that where you just go "wow."

influences.name: Grave Dancer's Union album
influences.context: I grew up [and] I learned how to play guitar because of that album

influences.name: The Rolling Stones
influences.context: "Make Her Laugh" is a laid-back, Stones-inspired jam

influences.name: The Smiths
influences.context: the smoky guitars of "Social Butterfly" have the dreamy aesthetic of '80s indie-pop acts such as the Smiths
